text:
Maya (CS): Morning — we have 14 affected accounts from last night's embeddings outage. Drafting comms for impacted customers. Putting draft below — pls review for tone, SLO credit asks, and who to loop for higher-touch accounts.

Liam (CS): thanks. can we prioritize top 5 renewals? list attached in Notion: https://redwood.at/nb/impacted-top5

Janelle (Support): +1 to top5. Also flag onboarding customers in week 1-3 — they saw failures in batch embed jobs.

Ben (Eng): root cause summary: degradation in embedding microservice after autoscaler config bug; cache thrashing caused 5xx for background batches. Mitigation deployed at 03:45 UTC, full recovery by 04:10 UTC. Working on formal RCA.

IncidentBot: Deployment rolled back to stable commit 6b3f2a at 03:46 UTC. Alert closed at 04:11 UTC.

Maya (CS): draft email below — include explicit credits and an offer for a technical sync for affected accounts. Please suggest edits.

```
Subject: Update on last night's embedding failures — actions we're taking

Hi <CustomerName>,

We want to apologize for the disruption you experienced between 03:20 and 04:10 UTC on <date>. Our telemetry shows that embedding requests for some background batch jobs returned 5xx errors or timed out.

What happened:
- A misconfiguration in our autoscaler caused a spike in eviction and cache miss rates for the embedding service.
- This led to temporary failed background batches and retries, affecting a subset of accounts.

What we did:
- Rolled back the autoscaler config and restored stable binaries (03:46 UTC).
- Backfilled failed batches where possible and retriggered jobs (completed by 07:00 UTC).

What we're doing next:
- Full RCA with timeline and permanent config guardrails (ETA 48 hours).
- Offering credits for impacted usage and optional technical syncs.

If you'd like a dedicated session to review impact or rollout mitigations, reply to this email and we'll schedule.

Again, sorry for the interruption.

Thanks,
Maya
Customer Success
```

Liam (CS): wording looks good. For top5 renewals, propose adding a proactive credit of 5% + free enablement hour. Suggest call script in reply.

Aaron (AM): +1. I'll reach out to the three largest accounts directly and offer an optional sync this week.

Janelle (Support): small nit: replace 'backfilled where possible' with 'we retried and resumed failed background jobs; data integrity verified' — reduces customer concern.

Ben (Eng): adding: final RCA will include exact logs and offending autoscaler policy lines. We'll also add unit tests to prevent regression.

Maya (CS): thanks. I'll update email and ship to impacted list at 13:30 PT. action items:
- Maya: final email + send 13:30 PT
- Liam: prepare renewal-specific script and credit amounts
- Aaron: 1:1 outreach to top accounts
- Ben: share RCA draft within 48h
- Janelle: confirm backfill completion and any outstanding jobs

Liam (CS): noted. tagging @exec for any approval on credits: @Olivia (Head of CS), @Sam (Finance)

Olivia (Head of CS): approve up to 7% credits for top 3 accounts and 3% for the rest. escalate to finance if >7%.

Sam (Finance): acknowledged. please CC finance when finalizing credit numbers.

Maya (CS): sending updated draft now, will post final thread when sent. :white_check_mark:
